decisions_log.decision: Used three separate test files (one per AC), each with its own top-level jest.mock for @/data/changelog.json.
decisions_log.rationale: jest.isolateModules causes a dual-React-instance error (two copies of react in the same process) because the module's fresh React diverges from the one held by @testing-library/react. Separate files with static top-level mocks avoid this entirely and produce the cleanest, most readable tests.

decisions_log.decision: Count is derived from changelog.length (the raw imported array) rather than entries.length (the sorted copy).
decisions_log.rationale: The sorted copy is identical in length; using the raw import makes the intent explicit — we are counting all entries in the data file, not a filtered or sorted subset.

decisions_log.decision: Applied mt-1 text-sm spacing to the count paragraph (vs mt-2 text-base on the description).
decisions_log.rationale: The count is metadata/secondary information; a smaller font and tighter top-margin visually subordinates it to the heading while keeping it distinct from the description paragraph below.
